questions.question: In this marked part, what appears under “The Ninth”?
questions.answer: No passage is given there. It is blank.

questions.question: Based on the marked part alone, how many ideas or events can a student study from “The Ninth”?
questions.answer: None, because no content is written in that section.

questions.answer: It shows that the passage has a title but no explanation under it.

questions.answer: No. The marked part does not explain its topic.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the marked part by itself?
questions.answer: It only presents the heading “The Ninth” without any further text.

questions.answer: Admitting the text is incomplete.

questions.answer: It shows “The Ninth.”

questions.question: Is there any sentence after that label inside the marked passage?
questions.answer: No, there is not.

questions.question: What kind of passage is this by itself: a full explanation, a short summary, or only a heading?
questions.answer: It is only a heading.

questions.question: Does the marked passage give proof, examples, or reasons for anything?
questions.answer: No. It gives none of those.

questions.question: How should a student answer a question asking for a detail from this section?
questions.answer: The student should say that no detail is given.

questions.question: What is the overall form of the target passage?
questions.answer: It is a section label without a body.

questions.question: What is the only written content inside the marked target passage?
questions.answer: A section title that says “The Ninth.”

questions.question: Does the marked passage include any people, places, or actions?
questions.answer: No, it does not.

questions.question: What can we infer about the passage length under this heading?
questions.answer: There is no actual paragraph there in the marked part.

questions.question: Is there any message in this target passage about belief, character, or worship?
questions.answer: No message like that is stated in the marked part itself.

questions.question: What is the clearest main-point statement for this target passage?
questions.answer: The target passage contains only the heading for the ninth section.

questions.question: What numbered part is named in the marked passage?
questions.answer: The ninth part.

questions.question: What explanation follows that name inside the target passage?
questions.answer: No explanation follows it.

questions.question: Does this passage support making a summary of ideas?
questions.answer: No, because no ideas are written there.

questions.question: What is the safest conclusion a reader can make from this marked part?
questions.answer: Only that a ninth section is being introduced.

questions.question: How can a student show strong comprehension even when the text is blank?
questions.answer: By correctly noticing that the passage gives no content beyond the heading.

questions.answer: “The Ninth.”
